turns.text: Hi Divya, this is Tara from JioHotstar. I'm calling because your JioHotstar Mobile annual plan is set to end on 1 August, since the UPI AutoPay on it was cancelled. Would you prefer English or Hindi?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Hi Tara, yes that is correct. I'll stick to English, please, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it, thanks Divya. Just curious, what made you cancel the AutoPay earlier?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, it's more that the bank reissued my card and the AutoPay just stopped working. I hadn't realized it was cancelled yet, so I meant to sort it out back then.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Ah, got it, that happens sometimes with new cards. No worries at all. Since you're a loyal subscriber, we have a special gesture for you: 5% off if you reactivate before 1 August. Would you give it another shot?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Oh, that's very kind! Yes, I would definitely try to give it another shot. Let me just check if I can do that. Can you tell me more about what I need to do to reactivate the plan?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, Divya. Just open the JioHotstar app on your phone, go to your account section, and you'll see the option to reactivate your plan there. The 5% discount is already applied to your account, so you don't need any link or code. Shall I wait while you check, or do you have any other questions?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Okay, I'm on it. One quick question, to be sure: will the new billing date just be the same as the original one in August, or will it be today's date?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great question. Your new billing cycle will start from the day you reactivate, so it'll be today's date, not the original August date. Does that work for you?

turns.speaker: persona
turns.text: Yes, that works perfectly. Thank you, Tara. I'm going to go check that right away.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's great to hear, Divya! Just go ahead and reactivate in the app, and you'll be all set. Is there anything else I can help you with?
